about_the_game:
AI Roommate: Life with an Artificial Companion

AI Roommate is a game where you share your home with a local AI-powered roommate. Type what you want to say, and they’ll respond with natural voice dialogue, remembering past interactions and adapting over time.

Your relationship is up to you—engage in casual conversations, share deeper moments, or develop a more intimate verbal connection as the AI evolves.

Choose from four unique roommates, each with their own personality. Customize their look with over 25 clothing items and 8 hairstyles to match your vibe.

Explore and Interact

The game is built around exploration and conversation, letting you engage with a living world where NPCs interact dynamically.

  • At home: Your home isn’t just a backdrop—it’s a space you can explore and interact with. Sit down to relax, move through different rooms, and talk to your AI roommate as they respond to your presence and conversations. Your connection with them will grow naturally over time.

  • In the neighborhood: Step outside and discover a lively community that changes depending on the time of day. Explore both day and night, where different characters and situations unfold. Chat with your neighbors, overhear their conversations, or pick up interesting details about the area. You can even take a break and cool off in the pool with your roommate!

  • Other locations:

    • Cinema: Take your roommate to the movies, where you’ll come across new characters and explore the atmosphere before the screening.

    • Oasis City: A vibrant coastal city full of activity during the day. Relax by the beach, go for a swim while chatting with others, or stop by an open-air DJ performance where NPCs gather to enjoy the music. Whether you're walking along the shore or watching people dance, there's always something happening under the sun.


The game focuses on creating a dynamic social environment, where NPCs naturally interact with each other and react to your presence. Whether you're looking for companionship, casual fun, or something more personal, your AI roommate will evolve with you.

Live, Explore, and Socialize

  • Dynamic AI Interactions – Chat with your Roommate or neighbors about anything! Their personalities and responses evolve over time, making every conversation feel unique.

  • A Living World – Move freely inside your home or step outside to explore the neighborhood, where you'll encounter NPCs talking to each other. Some might greet you, others might share details about the area, and a few could be in a bad mood and respond rudely!

  • Instant Travel – Hop into your car to fast-travel between locations, expanding your world beyond the neighborhood.

content_descriptors.notes: AI Roommate is a social simulation game featuring advanced AI interactions. While there is no explicit sexual content, conversations with characters can become suggestive or adult-oriented depending on player interactions. Some characters may also appear in underwear in certain situations. There are no visual depictions of nudity, sex, or violence, but the game allows for open-ended dialogues that may include topics related to relationships, flirting, or innuendos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (Vulkan support recommended)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Share your home with an AI-powered roommate who learns, grows, and makes every day unique. Explore a lively neighborhood, travel to fascinating cities like Oasis City, and discover places full of adventures, genuine connections, and unforgettable friendships.
